recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Future changes to the valueset-supplement extension wording should be made in HL7/fhir-extensions, not by reintroducing the extension definition into core.
issue_request: FHIR-39052 was a Published/Persuasive R5 FHIR-core ValueSet ballot issue asking that the valueset-supplement extension define the word supplement by linking it to CodeSystem supplement guidance instead of leaving the phrase as 'particular supplement'.
initial_application: The change was applied in HL7/fhir-extensions rather than in current core source: commit 0b275112 updated the StructureDefinition description and commit f2e8099 updated the differential definition to use 'particular [CodeSystem supplement](codesystem.html#supplements)'. Core history shows dd468d4f17 removed extension definitions from R5 source, so no active core StructureDefinition source remains for this extension.
additional_context: The current core checkout still references the extension from ValueSet operation/narrative files, and generated R5 history shows the clarified wording, but the authoritative current definition is in /home/jmandel/work/fhir-extensions. Later related issues FHIR-40761 and FHIR-44898 refine supplement-declaration placement and ValueSet composition rules without reversing the FHIR-39052 clarification.
reconciliation: No core files were changed. The combined branch received an empty external-repo audit commit documenting that the issue's current source of truth is the Extension Pack and that the requested wording is already correct there.

related_jiras.note: Later FHIR-extensions issue for the same extension added ValueSet.compose.include and ValueSet.compose.exclude contexts and explanatory intro text; it was useful context but not part of this core seed decision.

Later FHIR-core ValueSet issue clarified that supplements are declared with valueset-supplement or useSupplement rather than by include/exclude system references; it supports leaving FHIR-39052's link intact.
